name: token-colour
title: Token colour — a custom property, resolved
description: Reads a CSS custom property to a concrete value, and a React hook that re-reads it when the theme changes — data-theme is an attribute swap, so nothing re-renders on its own and a canvas keeps yesterday’s palette. SSR-safe by fallback. React only.
author: Amir Salmani <hi@amirsalmani.com>
